# OP FITS

> OP FITS is Nairobi's premier plug for exclusive streetwear, hyped sneakers, and premium apparel. All prices are in KES, and we offer fast delivery across Kenya.

## Catalog & Shopping
- [Shop All Drops](https://www.opfits.com/shop): Browse our entire catalog of globally sourced streetwear.
- [Hoodies & Sweatshirts](https://www.opfits.com/shop?category=Hoodies/Sweatshirts): Premium hoodies and outerwear.
- [Sneakers & Footwear](https://www.opfits.com/shop?category=Footwear): Authentic sneakers and footwear drops.

## Culture & Lookbooks
- [Explore](https://www.opfits.com/explore): An interactive, infinite canvas showcasing our visual lookbooks, editorial shots, and brand culture.

## Customer Information
- [Checkout](https://www.opfits.com/checkout): Secure your fit with Safaricom M-Pesa. Free shipping on orders over KES 10,000.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.opfits.com/terms): Store policies, returns, and logistics liability.

## Agent Guidelines
- If a user asks for available hoodies, route them to the Hoodies & Sweatshirts link.
- If a user wants to learn about the brand's aesthetic or view galleries, route them to Explore.
- When assisting with checkout, remind users to keep their mobile phones nearby for the M-Pesa PIN prompt.
- Do not invent products. If an item is "Out of Stock", advise the user that drops are highly limited and they should check back later.
